review.body: { let old = self . closed . carrier () ; let old_policy = & old . frames . last () . ok_or (Error :: Response) ? . marker_policy ; let new_policy = & replacement . frames . first () . ok_or (Error :: Response) ? . marker_policy ; if ! self . halted || new_policy . edition == old_policy . edition || new_policy . published_at <= old_policy . published_at || new_policy . sequence == old_policy . sequence { return Err (Error :: Response) ; } let (continuity , publication) = match & response { Response :: Reanchor { continuity , publication } => { if new_policy . initial_marker == old_policy . initial_marker { return Err (Error :: Response) ; } (continuity , publication) } Response :: Follow { divergence , superseded , continuity , publication , } => { if * divergence >= old . frames . len () || * superseded != old . frames [* divergence ..] . iter () . map (| f | f . closure . clone ()) . collect :: < Vec < _ > > () { return Err (Error :: Response) ; } (continuity , publication) } } ; if continuity . is_empty () || publication . is_empty () || ! deployment . published_response (old , & replacement , & response) { return Err (Error :: Response) ; } let mut next = consume (replacement , verifier , live) ? ; next . response = Some (response) ; Ok (next) }
review.item_premise: Public complete old and replacement packages and response disclosures are recorded. Live verification precedes independent semantic restoration; immutable access retains the frozen state. The declared live and response verifiers supply external premises only.
